Daily Devotional

November 10

12 Hope deferred maketh the heart sick: but when the desire cometh, it is a tree of life. (Proverbs 13:12 KJV)

This scripture is so true, and if you hope for something that doesn’t come to pass, then it does make the heart sick. So many people don’t want to ever build up their hope for anything, that way they won’t ever get disappointed. That is the wrong approach to life, as hope is what enables our faith, and without hope, you never will have the faith to receive the good things that God has in store for His children (Romans 8:25). This world doesn’t like to hope for anything. The medical profession will always give you the worse possible diagnosis, to not get your hope up. How can you ever believe for healing without faith, and without hope to enable your faith? Faith is the substance of things hoped for (Hebrews 11:1). Without hope, your faith will never bring into the physical, what you have already been given by God’s grace.

Note that when you realize your hopes, it is a tree of life. We need to hope for godly things, and work to realize the hope. The thing to guard against is to have false hopes that can not be realized, as that will cause you to have a sick heart many times. If you hope for godly things, and pursue them through prayer, the Lord will help you receive those things (Matthew 7:7-8), and it will be so rewarding that you will be happy you hoped for them. Just be realistic in what you hope for, so that you will not be disappointed all the time. Stay focused on God, and He will give you the desires of your heart (Mark 11:24). So remember, that without hope, your faith will never bring about the things you desire from the Lord. Thank you Lord for all your blessings that you give us children.

Devotional by Pastor Joe W. Green, www.Infinite-Faith.com
